desc:

Shutdowns = Updates/Game patches

*This game is intended to be played on PC or Xbox but is accessible to mobile players, the mobile codes are slightly behind so not all game features are available*

⚔️ Fight enemies and bosses to get drops and level up your skills! 
⛏️ Mine ores and craft them into armor and weapons in the blacksmith!
🎊 Roll for a Blessing Magic!
✨ Explore the map and find artifacts to learn magic! Artifacts will spawn depending on the season!
🎉 Max your skills and unlock level 100 skill capes!
🌎 Do raids with your friends!

🎮CONTROLS🎮
M: Menu
F: Block
R: Free Fall
Left CTRL: Run
Q: Roll
Jump + Q: Dash
Equip Weapon(4) + E: Counter
Double Jump: "Space + Space"
Parkour: Double Jump on wall
H: Spawn Mount

Tags: Adventure, RPG, Fantasy, MMORPG, Magic, Fighting
